purpose: A production line for making more articles without lowering truth, uniqueness, usefulness or public verification standards.
capacityRule: Maintain draft inventory, but do not raise publication cadence or create a BOOTH SKU for every article without matched-age first-party evidence and reusable-product value.

stages.action: Select one existing opportunity or generate a raw combination from the keyword matrix.
stages.passWhen: All five fields are concrete and describe one observable job.
stages.failWhen: The topic applies to almost everyone or is only a broad theme.

stages.action: Compare the five-axis fingerprint against published receipts, paid queue, free queue and all research titles.
stages.passWhen: No hard duplicate exists and any adjacent item has a different artifact or decision.
stages.failWhen: Only wording, count, adjective or platform differs.

stages.action: Run the source playbook and open the current official sources.
stages.passWhen: Every material factual frame has a current source and professional boundaries are explicit.
stages.failWhen: A promised outcome depends on an unsupported fact, outdated rule or professional judgment.

stages.action: Search the exact reader + moment + failure + artifact on note and BOOTH.
stages.passWhen: The angle is either relatively distinct or materially better for the target reader.
stages.failWhen: The only difference is more prompts, more pages or cosmetic packaging.

stages.action: Define what the free article completes and what implementation depth a paid layer adds.
stages.passWhen: Free content is independently useful and paid content adds workflow, editable assets, exceptions or acceptance criteria.
stages.failWhen: The free content is a thin teaser or paid content is merely longer.

stages.passWhen: The archetype naturally delivers the selected artifact.
stages.failWhen: The archetype forces an invented story, metric or customer example.

stages.action: Draft in the ノウハウ共有おじさん voice with one reader, one situation and one outcome.
stages.passWhen: A first-time reader can complete one small action without buying.
stages.failWhen: The draft relies on jargon, vague motivation, unsupported biography or scattered topics.

stages.action: Run title, claim, structure, link, image and paid-value checks.
stages.passWhen: All material claims are sourced, title is specific and natural, cover is prepared and CTA is zero or one verified exact-intent destination.
stages.failWhen: Any unsupported number, fake urgency, expired campaign tag, guessed URL or unrelated CTA remains.

stages.action: Publish only through the authorized queue and verify the reader-visible result strictly.
stages.passWhen: Logged-out or reader-visible verification confirms the expected state.
stages.failWhen: A click occurred but the reader-visible result was not confirmed.

stages.action: Capture 24h, 72h and 7d first-party metrics at equal ages and choose promote, revise, hold or retire.
stages.passWhen: The decision states what is known and keeps article evidence separate from cluster conclusions.
stages.failWhen: Missing metrics are treated as zero or one result declares a cluster winner.

hardStops: missing current source for a material claim
invented biography, case study, demand, metric or result
professional decision disguised as a template
publicationBoundary: This workflow expands research and draft capacity. It does not re-enable disabled loops, republish completed Aug 24 items or authorize publication above the current experiment cadence.
